finalists.label: Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome
finalists.why: Strong evidence from arm span-to-height ratio, left corneal clouding, increased range of motion in joints, and high Beighton score.

finalists.label: Hypermobile joint disorder
finalists.why: Evidence from increased range of motion in joints and high Beighton score, but less comprehensive than Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome.

finalists.label: Homocystinuria
finalists.why: Some evidence from birth measurements and high-arched palate, but not as strong as Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome.

frontier_selector.why: Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome is chosen due to its comprehensive explanation of the patient's symptoms, including joint hypermobility, skin features, and ocular findings.
